question: The density of population of India as per the Census of 1951 is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 117 per sq km.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Census 1951:-**

 
 
• There were approximately 117 people living in every square kilometer of land in India in 1951.
